patches.summary: Add `auth login` chromedp + Auth0 SPA localStorage harvest as a sibling to press-emitted auth.go.
patches.reason: The press's auth_simple.go.tmpl emits set-token/status/logout for bearer_token auth, but Peloton's bearer is gated behind Auth0 SPA login — there is no public token-issue endpoint, and pasting from DevTools is the only manual alternative. Mirrors the dominos pattern (auth_login.go alongside auth.go).
patches.validated_outcome: `peloton-pp-cli auth login` opens Chrome via chromedp, polls localStorage for the Auth0 SPA cache key, extracts body.access_token, saves via cfg.SaveTokens. The bare auth.go AddCommand list now includes newAuthLoginCmd.

patches.summary: Add `discoveries` novel command — walks recent workouts, fetches each ride's playlist in parallel, collects songs flagged liked=true in-class, dedupes by song id with a times_played counter.
patches.reason: No Peloton UI surfaces this view; likes are stored Peloton-side per ride playback rather than per-song globally. This is the original peloton-pp-cli's headline novel feature and the kind of compound use case the catalog's transcendence rubric expects. Uses the press's typed Cobra flags + agent-output helpers (printJSONFiltered) so --agent / --select / --json / --compact all work.
patches.validated_outcome: `peloton-pp-cli discoveries --help` registers cleanly. RunE uses flags.newClient() + the press's generic Get(path, params) client, mirroring the press-emitted endpoint commands.

upstream_tracking.context: auth_browser.go.tmpl currently handles browser-cookie auth only (cookie/composed types via pycookiecheat). Auth0 SPA APIs that cache tokens in localStorage (Peloton, plausibly others) need a chromedp + localStorage-key-scan template path. Until then, sites in this class fall back to the dominos pattern of hand-adding auth_login.go.

upstream_tracking.issue: auth_simple.go.tmpl AuthHeader() treats auth_flow_input env vars as candidate bearer tokens
upstream_tracking.context: When auth.type=bearer_token and the spec declares auth_flow_input env vars (PELOTON_USERNAME, PELOTON_PASSWORD), the emitted AuthHeader() checks them BEFORE falling through to AccessToken. With PELOTON_USERNAME exported in the shell, every API call sends `Authorization: Bearer <username>` and 401s, even when a valid access_token is saved. Reproduced on this CLI: `export PELOTON_USERNAME=anything; peloton-pp-cli identity me` → HTTP 401. Workaround documented in README (inline-scope env vars on `auth login` only, never `export`). Suggested fix upstream: respect AuthEnvVarKind — `auth_flow_input` and `harvested` should never be tried as the bearer token; only `per_call`-kind vars and AccessToken should populate AuthHeader.
